about: Haiku content judge (Claude Haiku as a blind judge) of greedy outputs: pin = the Episode 2 multi-stream config with the batching switches (no WY), WY = + DF_GDN_WY, plain = the plain (non-speculative) vLLM preset of Episode 2. Long prompts = code reviews of slices of tt-metal source, 2k-8.5k tokens. 'both orders' = every pair judged twice with A/B swapped; counts are summed over both orders. 'better' and 'contradictions' list (other, pin). Tallied from the judge transcripts (one line per pair).

256_tokens_first_check.prompts: 5 exact + 9 long, single order, every text cut at 256 tokens (ignore_eos)

256_tokens_noise_floor.prompts: 5 exact + 30 long, both orders, every long text cut at 256 tokens

1536_tokens.prompts: 30 long, both orders, natural EOS with a 1536 cap: all 90 texts hit the cap (marked cut for the judge)

4096_tokens.prompts: 30 long, both orders, natural EOS with a 4096 cap

width_check: the same 30 long prompts at 1 live and inside 4-live bursts: identical texts 30/30 on the pin and on WY (1536 cap; WY also at 4096)
